name: CubeSat solar panels
description: Small fold-out panels for a CubeSat.

name: Small solar array
description: Turns sunlight into electricity. Power drops fast the farther you go from the Sun.

name: Medium solar array
description: A good all-round solar array for Earth, the Moon and Mars.

name: Large solar array
description: Large wings for power-hungry spacecraft or missions far from the Sun.

name: Giant solar wings
description: Huge wings like Juno's. The only way to use solar power at Jupiter.

name: RTG (nuclear power)
description: Makes electricity from the heat of decaying plutonium. Works anywhere, even far from the Sun, and slowly weakens over the years.

name: Small battery (200 Wh)
description: Stores energy for when the spacecraft is in shadow.

name: Medium battery (800 Wh)
description: Enough to get most spacecraft through a long eclipse.

name: Large battery (2000 Wh)
description: A big battery for power-hungry spacecraft and long shadows.

name: No radiation shielding
description: Fine near Earth, the Moon and Mars.

name: Radiation vault
description: A thick metal box that protects the electronics. Needed at Jupiter.

name: Heavy radiation vault
description: Extra-thick protection. The spacecraft survives longer in Jupiter's radiation.
